G3166645.description: Serravalle (Romagnol: Saravâl) is one of the nine castelli of San Marino. It has a population of 11,226 inhabitants (of whom 2,000 are of foreign origin) and an area of 10.53 km2 (4 sq. mi.).

G3168070.description: The City of San Marino (Italian: Città di San Marino), also known simply as San Marino and locally as Città, is the capital city of the Republic of San Marino and one of its nine castelli. It has a population of 4,118.

G3170472.description: Poggio Chiesanuova is a curazia of San Marino, in the castello of Chiesanuova.

G3177260.description: Falciano is a curazia of San Marino. It belongs to the municipality of Serravalle.

G3177564.description: Dogana (lit. 'Customs House'; Romagnol: Dughena) is a curazia of San Marino.

G6941147.description: Fiorina is a curazia of San Marino, in the castello of Domagnano. Fiorella is the most populated curazia of Domagnano.

G7302190.description: Murata is a curazia of San Marino, in the castello of the City of San Marino. It is the most populated curazia of the City of San Marino.

G8199067.description: Cailungo is a settlement in San Marino comprising two curazie, Cailungo di Sopra and Cailungo di Sotto, in the castello of Borgo Maggiore.

G8199071.description: Valdragone is a settlement in San Marino comprising two curazie, Valdragone di Sopra and Valdragone di Sotto, in the castello of Borgo Maggiore.
